name: ORD_NLP_ERROR
description: This table contains information about NLP error codes and error messages for imaging orders that failed processing by Nebula.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the order record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: NLP_ERROR_CODE_C_NAME
columns.description: The AIServices error code or other Radiant specific error code that was returned for this order if it failed being processed by the AIEF Nebula model.

columns.name: NLP_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The specific error message that AIServices returned or Radiant specific error messages for when an order was sent to Nebula for processing but failed for one reason or another.
